meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 跑完迁移脚本后，Claude 接手需要人判断的收尾工作：按 handoff.json 排查失败步骤、授予 owner 角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、搬运 v1 自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你跑完 `bash migrate-v2.sh`，或提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: handoff.json 里有哪些失败的步骤？
say.note: Claude 读取 handoff.json 逐条排查

say.text: 帮我把 v2 的 owner 角色授予我
say.note: 确认用户 ID 后写入 owner 角色

say.text: 我 v1 有哪些自定义提交，怎么搬过来？
say.note: 对比 upstream 提交并给出处理选项

howto.what_en: Once migrate-v2.sh finishes, this skill has Claude do the judgment calls: triage failed steps from handoff.json, grant the owner role, run the shared-memory migration, reconcile container configs, and port custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggers after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes, or when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration" and similar phrases.

say_en.note: Claude reads handoff.json and walks each step

say_en.text: Grant me the v2 owner role
say_en.note: Confirms your user ID, then writes the role

say_en.text: Which v1 commits are custom, and how do I port them?
say_en.note: Diffs against upstream and offers options
